text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Add the flour and sugar. Whisk in the eggs. And next is, um…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I can't remember. And after I stayed up so late trying to memorize it, too… Now I'm just back to square one.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Will I really be able to finish this chiffon cake in time for my tea party with McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No, I can do this. I just need to memorize the recipe again, so I don't mess up… Yaaawn…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It doesn't seem like Satono Diamond got much sleep last night.
